xai.interpretation_note: SHAP values represent model contributions and should not be interpreted as causal evidence.

techniques.interpretation: Observed traffic is consistent with network service discovery behavior.
techniques.limitation: Network-flow evidence alone cannot establish malicious intent.

empty_mitre_output.reason: Available network-flow evidence was insufficient to support a confident ATT&CK technique mapping.

integration_principles: World Model determines future state probabilities.
SHAP explains the ML model prediction.
MITRE ATT&CK interprets observable network behavior.
SHAP feature contributions must not directly determine MITRE techniques.
Network-flow evidence does not prove attacker intent.
Insufficient evidence must produce no confident MITRE mapping.
